notes.title: 🦑👁️ JAPANESE LOCALIZATION UPDATE 1.999! 👁️🦑
notes.notes:
Dear Japanese-speaking followers, we extend our deepest gratitude for being part of our haunting journey! As we continue to explore the mysteries that lurk in the shadows, we invite you to plunge deeper into the abyss with the latest update for MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/1985ad2e0b6e70cfdf25a74a6729dd2a8a98cedb.png

🎌 EXPLORE THE UNSEEN IN YOUR NATIVE TONGUE!

Immerse yourself in the dark and mysterious world of our horror game, now fully localized in Japanese. From menus to dialogue and even the intricate lore, experience the terror and beauty of "MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE" like never before.

🔍 DISCOVER ALL 4 ENDINGS, UNRAVEL THE LORE!

Embark on a journey to unveil the secrets hidden within the game's narrative. Seek out all four endings, collect journal pages scattered throughout the eerie house, and capture chillingly cute moments in this refined version of the game.

🐞 BUG FIXES - A SMOOTHER NIGHTMARE AWAITS!

In our relentless pursuit of perfection, we've exorcised a lurking bug to ensure a smoother, more immersive experience. Your journey through the unknown is now free from eldritch interruptions.

🌐 MORE LANGUAGES ON THE HORIZON!

As we embrace the global community of horror enthusiasts, be on the lookout for additional language support in the coming year. The cultists know no bounds, and we're committed to bringing it to you in languages that resonate with terror.

👻 UPDATE NOW AND FACE THE UNSEEN IN JAPANESE!

Download the latest update for "MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE" on Steam and dive into the abyss with newfound terror in your native language. Unravel the mysteries, face the terrors, and remember - Cthulhu will rise again. 👁️🦑

notes.title: Update 1.666
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/e5b1477d5f0291acab7f0bda550a529a878ce437.png

We have just launched our first update for MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE with a few minor bug fixes and improvements to gameplay.

UPDATE NOTES: 

 Frame rate cap button added to options menu
 Escape key for options as default
 New warning screen to warn players  (and  set the mood)
 Decreased door interaction area
 Changed textures of the books and note pages to look better on lower resolutions
 Remade manga and night text graphics to be less pixelated
 TV static will always be the same volume and not randomized
 Fixed swinging doors so they can't trap players
 Disabled photomode diorama until it is visible
 Now screenshots are automatically added to your Steam library
 Made all doors and walls opaque 
 Opening books and acquiring letters now trigger sounds to make the 3D sounds that stop during pauses less abrupt 
 Changed text in the diorama to clarify options
 Tweaked drawer, lamp and note interaction ranges
 Added a button to the lamp to show where you should interact with it
 Added new logo to the photomode
 Tweaked photomode filters and frames
 Fixed UI elements in different resolutions


Please stay tuned for the next update coming out in December that will feature a Japanese translation.

Thank you for your continued support,

Virtua Worlds
